title: 列車—軌道耦合振動分析
summary: 列車—軌道耦合振動分析以「車軌接觸模態耦合取樣與穩定性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。車輛與軌道透過輪軌接觸互相交換作用力，車體舒適與輪軌力峰值不是同一輸出，模型必須分清質量層次與接觸條件。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops vehicle-track contact modal coupling sampling and stability through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Vehicle and track exchange forces through wheel contact; carbody comfort and peak contact force are different outputs, and the model must distinguish mass levels and contact conditions. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=4.7213 Hz。模型邊界：單質量線性彈簧；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg；y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg。只把 m1 增加百分之十，y=1064.52 kg。模型邊界：兩個自由質量間相對運動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.7213 Hz. Boundary: Single mass and linear spring; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg; y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg. Increasing only m1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=1064.52 kg. Boundary: Relative motion between two free masses; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 單質量固有頻率與輪軌約化質量
stages.titleEn: Single-mass natural frequency & Wheel-track reduced mass
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單質量固有頻率」與「輪軌約化質量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Single-mass natural frequency" and "Wheel-track reduced mass": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單質量固有頻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Single-mass natural frequency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單質量固有頻率」如何影響列車—軌道耦合振動分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-mass natural frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 質量層次選擇決定模態的物理意義。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.7213 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單質量線性彈簧。使用自由衰減頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單質量固有頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Chosen mass level determines the physical meaning of the mode. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 4.7213 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Single mass and linear spring. Use free-decay frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Single-mass natural frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單質量固有頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-mass natural frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=4.7213 Hz。模型邊界：單質量線性彈簧；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.7213 Hz. Boundary: Single mass and linear spring; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用加速度計與模型質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use free-decay frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Single-mass natural frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用加速度計與模型質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「單質量固有頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use free-decay frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using accelerometer and model mass, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Single-mass natural frequency. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「單質量固有頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單質量線性彈簧如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度造成偏離的合成觀察，以自由衰減頻率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale. Explain which evidence in free-decay frequency distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
